headline: Why the decline in inflation in our country is an "arithmetic phenomenon" rather than a real drop in prices
summary: Economist Stoyan Panchev told Money.bg that slower price increases mean temporary disinflation. He said prices are still rising, only more slowly.
why: Inflation measures the pace of price increases and drives central bank policy, bond yields and real returns for investors.
